vehicle: uniform-q4-group64-v1 + hybrid token graph (device activations + 512-way expert table)
gpu_timestamp_authority: completed MTLCommandBuffer GPUStartTime/GPUEndTime only; never a CPU-wait proxy
box_note: Apple M3 Ultra, 60 GPU cores, 96 GB unified, 819 GB/s published peak

theoretical_weight_bytes.note: Q4 group-64 codes+f16 scales only; activations and compact-slab host memcpy are separate

theoretical_temp_bytes.note: workspace is resident and reused; readback is 48×512 router logits + one vocab lm-head snapshot

stage_table.reason: device embedding lookup command buffer (encode+submit+wait)
stage_table.measurement_method: host Instant around embed_into; GPU ns = GPUEndTime-GPUStartTime after wait

stage_table.reason: mixed prefix CB for 36 DeltaNet layers: mixer + shared-expert + router + norm. GPU time is not split.
stage_table.removable_vs_necessary: physically necessary (mixer); CB split removable if device top-k lands
stage_table.measurement_method: host Instant around prefix encode+commit_and_wait; GPU ns is mixed

stage_table.reason: mixed prefix CB for 12 GQA layers: mixer + shared-expert + router + norm. GPU time is not split.
stage_table.removable_vs_necessary: physically necessary (mixer); CB split removable if device top-k lands
stage_table.measurement_method: host Instant around prefix encode+commit_and_wait; GPU ns is mixed

stage_table.reason: post-attn RMSNorm + router Q4 matvec are encoded into the mixed prefix CB. Isolated GPU ns is not measurable without splitting the CB (forbidden: would change token identity). Host extract is identity rows router_readback + host_topk.
stage_table.measurement_method: CPU Instant around encode_residual_rmsnorm + router matvec only; GPU absorbed into prefix

stage_table.reason: shared-expert SwiGLU MLP is encoded into the mixed prefix CB. Isolated GPU ns is not measurable.
stage_table.measurement_method: CPU Instant around encode_shared_mlp only; GPU absorbed into prefix

stage_table.reason: rewrite the live top-10 expert gpuAddress table (or first-touch triplet upload). Payloads stay resident.
stage_table.removable_vs_necessary: removable if a 512-way resident table needs no per-token rewrite
stage_table.measurement_method: host Instant around ensure_selected_expert_table + route id/weight writes

stage_table.reason: 512-way expert-table wave is encoded into the mixed suffix CB with combine. Isolated GPU ns is not measurable.
stage_table.measurement_method: CPU Instant around dispatch_qwen80_device_expert_table_tcb only; GPU absorbed into suffix

stage_table.reason: mixed suffix CB: routed-expert table + shared-gate + residual add. GPU time is not split. Named moe_combine because that is the historical bucket; moe_routed is absorbed here.
stage_table.removable_vs_necessary: physically necessary (combine); CB split removable with device top-k + fused layer CB
stage_table.measurement_method: host Instant around suffix encode+commit_and_wait; GPU ns is mixed

stage_table.reason: final RMSNorm + lm-head Q4 matvec command buffer (encode+submit+wait). Logits snapshot and argmax are separate identity phases.
stage_table.measurement_method: host Instant around terminal encode+commit_and_wait; GPU ns = GPUEndTime-GPUStartTime

stage_table.reason: Q4 matvecs are encoded into embed/prefix/suffix/terminal CBs. Isolated per-matvec GPU ns would require per-kernel counter samples that change token identity on this GPU family.
stage_table.measurement_method: CPU Instant around encode_q4_matvec; GPU absorbed. Dispatch count is native.q4_matvec_dispatches

stage_table.reason: 512-way device expert table is the production path. host_expert_payload_bind is the host fallback and is not entered. Table rewrite is moe_table_build, not this stage.
stage_table.measurement_method: not entered when qwen80_device_expert_table_enabled(); zero is N/A, not a measurement bug

stage_table.reason: prefix CB wait has already returned; this is the host memcpy of 512 router logits that forces CPU top-k.
stage_table.removable_vs_necessary: removable if device top-k consumes on-device logits
stage_table.measurement_method: host Instant around snapshot_f32(router_logits)

stage_table.reason: host softmax + top-10 + renormalize on 512 logits. Serial: suffix cannot encode until route ids exist.
stage_table.measurement_method: host Instant around source_qwen80_topk_router

stage_table.reason: terminal CB wait has returned; host memcpy of vocab logits for greedy argmax.
stage_table.removable_vs_necessary: removable if device argmax / sampled-id feedback
stage_table.measurement_method: host Instant around snapshot_f32(logits)

stage_table.reason: lowest-id-wins greedy over tokenizer vocab on the host.
stage_table.measurement_method: host Instant around the argmax scan

stage_table.reason: named residual: position increment, rss cap, layer-loop overhead, and any host between closed phases. This is the 0.37 s class of cost the old stage print hid.
stage_table.removable_vs_necessary: mostly bookkeeping; investigate if it grows
stage_table.measurement_method: token wall minus closed phases; sealed into this bucket at end()

stage_table.reason: device silu_mul encode wall. GPU is inside the mixed prefix CB.
stage_table.measurement_method: host Instant around encode_silu_mul; GPU absorbed into prefix

stage_table.reason: device shared-expert sandwich encode wall (3 Q4 + silu). GPU absorbed into prefix.
stage_table.measurement_method: host Instant around encode_shared_mlp

stage_table.reason: device qwen80_qkvz_rearrange_conv_l2_f32 encode wall. GPU absorbed into prefix.
stage_table.measurement_method: host Instant around the conv dispatch

stage_table.reason: device qwen80_gated_delta_decode_tg encode wall. GPU absorbed into prefix.
stage_table.measurement_method: host Instant around the recurrent dispatch

stage_table.reason: device residual RMSNorm encode on GQA layers. GPU absorbed into prefix.
stage_table.measurement_method: host Instant around encode_residual_rmsnorm in encode_gqa_mixer

stage_table.reason: device qwen80_gqa_qk_norm_rope_cache_f32 encode wall. GPU absorbed into prefix.
stage_table.measurement_method: host Instant around the rope dispatch

stage_table.reason: on the device path this is the host top-k (also identity host_topk). Host-path residual adds / gated-rms live here instead.
stage_table.removable_vs_necessary: top-k removable if device top-k lands
stage_table.measurement_method: host Instant around source_qwen80_topk_router (device path) or host residual ops (host path)

stage_table.reason: per-matvec commit_and_wait exists only on the host-activation fallback path. Production fused CBs sync once per prefix/suffix/embed/terminal; that wait is the parent mixed-CB wait, not this class.
stage_table.measurement_method: not entered when device activations are live; zero is N/A

stage_table.reason: Q4 weight traffic per token; theoretical 1892511808 B, observed mean 1892511808 B
stage_table.serial_vs_overlappable: overlappable with compute in principle; today serial behind CB waits
stage_table.measurement_method: geometry q4_matrix_bytes; observed via add_weight_bytes on encode

stage_table.reason: resident workspace 83080964 B + readback 706048 B/token
stage_table.removable_vs_necessary: workspace necessary; readbacks removable with on-device top-k/argmax
stage_table.measurement_method: geometry of DeviceActivationWorkspace + 48*512*4 + vocab*4

diagnosis.rationale: GPU 61% of wall, wait-minus-gpu 37.1 ms, host work 37.9 ms, 98 CBs. No single class exceeds the decision thresholds.
cannot_split: prefix CBs mix attention/DeltaNet + shared-expert + router matvec; GPU time is not split
suffix CBs mix routed-expert matvecs + silu + combine; GPU time is not split
per-kernel GPU timestamps require intrusive counter-sample attachments that change token identity on this GPU family
